lines: .summary-warn { margin: 0; background: var(--amber-bg); border: 1px solid var(--amber-line); color: var(--amber-ink); border-radius: 7px; padding: 10px 12px; font-weight: 600; }
.summary-warn-inline { background: var(--amber-bg); border: 1px solid var(--amber-line); color: var(--amber-ink); border-radius: 6px; padding: 3px 10px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; }
.empty { background: var(--panel); border: 1px dashed var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 36px 20px; text-align: center; color: var(--ink-soft); }
+.grid-wrap { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 10px; overflow-x: auto; }
+.tz-table th, .tz-table td, .tz-table-vertical th, .tz-table-vertical td { text-align: center; }
+.hour-head { font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-soft); font-weight: 700; padding: 6px 0 8px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
+.now-dot { display: block; font-size: 7px; line-height: 1; color: var(--green); }
+.city-name { border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0; font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; }
+  background: var(--green); color: #fff; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.6px;
+.city-sub { display: block; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; }
+.city-meta { display: block; color: var(--ink-faint); font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 500; }
+  font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
+.cell.awake { background: #fff; color: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line); }
+.cell.overlap { background: var(--green); color: #fff; font-weight: 800; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--green-dark); }
+  border: 1px solid var(--line); background: #fff; color: var(--ink-faint); border-radius: 50%;
+  width: 26px; height: 26px; line-height: 1; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; padding: 0;
+.mobile-city-head { background: #f5f8f9; border-radius: 7px; vertical-align: top; position: relative; }
+.mobile-hour { font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-soft); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; padding: 4px 2px; }
+  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 18px;
